briefdescription.para: This used for inline asm which may specify base reg and index reg for MemOp.

detaileddescription.para: e.g. ARR[eax + ecx*4], so no extra reg can be used for MemOp.

briefdescription.para: getStartLoc - Get the location of the first token of this operand.
getEndLoc - Get the location of the last token of this operand.
getLocRange - Get the range between the first and last token of this operand.
getOffsetOfLoc - Get the location of the offset operator.
print - Print a debug representation of the operand to the given stream.
isToken - Is this a token operand?
isImm - Is this an immediate operand?
isOffsetOfLocal - Do we need to emit code to get the offset of the local variable, rather than its value?

detaileddescription.para: Only valid when parsing MS-style inline assembly.

briefdescription.para: needAddressOf - Do we need to emit code to get the address of the variable/label?

detaileddescription.para: Only valid when parsing MS-style inline assembly.

briefdescription.para: isMem - Is this a memory operand?

isMemUseUpRegs - Is memory operand use up regs, for example, intel MS inline asm may use ARR[baseReg + IndexReg + ...] which may use up regs in [...] expr, so ARR[baseReg + IndexReg + ...] can not use extra reg for ARR.

detaileddescription.para: For example, calculating ARR address to a reg or use another base reg in PIC model.

briefdescription.para: isReg - Is this a register operand?
